interpretation: Prediction changes are not measurements of accuracy.
scoring_mode_note: Legacy heuristic scoring (evidence combiner and hand-set priors). No trained model produced these scores.

baseline_definitions.stage0_raw_max_score: Stage 0: strongest raw predictor score per function; no priors, no combination, no posterior.
baseline_definitions.legacy_prior_baseline: Posterior after the evidence_integration stage (heuristic evidence combiner and priors). The baseline_candidates and final_changes of this ledger are measured from it.

stages.name: metabolic_experiments

context.ranking_rule: more distinct measured evidence types, then probability closest to 0.5, then function key (exact ties only); no fitted weights, not a probability
context.mapping_note: reaction-level perturbation through a validated EC to reaction mapping; a protein absent from the model's gene rules is tested as a reaction, never as a gene knockout
context.model_condition_note: conditions are chosen where a reaction handles a metabolite whose declared exchange has the SAME species id or a shared compound xref (chebi, kegg.compound, bigg.metabolite, metanetx.chemical, seed.compound, hmdb, pubchem.compound, inchikey), from the template's condition_menu; they say where to look, are not evidence for the function and are not counted in the ranking
context.not_derived: no substrate or product is inferred from metabolite names; only exact model exchange ids in claim metadata or the explicit evidence file create transport/BGC experiments

assumptions_from_template.note: medium, biomass objective and maintenance are the template's assumptions, copied unchanged

stages.model_origin: supplied model; independence is not established by file format or presence of a reaction mapping table

baseline_focus.note: no baseline check was run (no growth, no budget or no mapped reaction): unavailable, not negative

locus_g6|EC|EC:4.4.4.4.note: whole-gene knockout versus the baseline medium: not a flux class and not a per-reaction requirement

locus_g6|EC|EC:6.2.1.1.note: whole-gene knockout versus the baseline medium: not a flux class and not a per-reaction requirement

stages.interpretation: Conditional model predictions under the stated medium, bounds and maintenance constraint; not observed phenotypes and not independent proof of gene function. A product or growth objective that needs the candidate is flagged and kept out of the evidence features.

stages.name: learned_integration
stages.reason: learned stage not requested: scores are the legacy heuristic ones (evidence combiner and hand-set priors); no trained model produced them
